---
title: "Trap: a header logo taller than the header"
mdbrand:
  brand: tall-logo
  style: note
---

The bundle's logo is four times taller than wide, in a PDF whose size mdbrand cannot
measure, so the header kept its default height. The mark printed across the
first line of every page; fancyhdr said so in the log, in words the check did
not recognise, and the build exited 0.
